newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar mixed, focus on expiring August.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar mixed, focus on expiring August.

text.p: LIFFE sugar was mixed by late afternoon, as the August-October spread widened out on the last day of trading for August.
By 1510 GMT, August was $2.60 higher at $330.00, while October was 20 cents lower at $317.00.
August had been the focus of attention, one trader said, but he noted good underlying support. "The trade in general is looking to buy," he said.
He cited Poland's flood problems and talk of the possibility of Russian buying as supportive factors.

"Heavy rainfall occuring mainly in southern regions of the country created huge losses in agriculture," Poland's Meteorology and Water Management Institute (IMGW) said in a statement on Wednesday. --Christopher Lyddon, London newsroom +44 171 542 7928
